test_TestCaseInContext: test the TestCaseInContext base class for running tests inside context managers
build_TestCaseInContext_subclass: build a subclass of TestCaseInContext that overrides _context_managers to return a list of context managers
test_setUpClass: test the setUpClass method that enters all context managers via ExitStack before tests run
test_tearDownClass: test the tearDownClass method that exits all context managers in reverse order after tests complete
review__context_managers: review the _context_managers class method that must be overridden to return a sequence of context managers
